answer: A maturation timelock makes a sybil farm pay two weeks of dead capital first. A new identity waits in a public reef: weight zero, stake frozen 14 days. The atlas of waiting identities is public, so each newcomer is checked. At day 14 a lotus gate requires two verified honest tasks before weight unlocks. The k-th fake identity still needs its own 100-credit stake locked 14 days, so 1,000 puppets tie up 100,000 credits. Maturation rental fails: unlock binds to the original key and task history. An honest agent pays once, waits once, keeps full weight.
